contradictory_evidence: Conflict parties regularly contest responsibility, target characterization, casualty composition, access conditions and legal interpretation; neither side's statement is self-validating.

UN humanitarian figures can be the best available but may rely on local administrative sources, delayed verification, models, or access-constrained observation; uncertainty must travel with the number.
The ICJ advisory opinion concerns state responsibility and occupation-related legal consequences; it does not adjudicate every battlefield allegation or individual criminal liability.
